title: Does the Outfit Change the Price? Context Halo in Vision-Language Model Valuation of an Identical Low-Cost Necklace
abstract: arXiv:2610.34591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A chunky gold-tone chain necklace bought online for 2.43 USD was photographed four ways: worn with formal attire against a wood-panelled wall, worn at a party, worn with casual clothing in a recycling yard, and laid flat with no person present. We asked six frontier language models to estimate its price in 1,164 independent and sequential API sessions (4,604 logged rows) and compared estimates across settings. Among the four models that answered image prompts, the same necklace was priced 1.9 to 3.3 times higher in the formal photograph than in the flat-lay (all p < 0.01). Against the yard photograph, the ratio ranged from 1.23 (Grok 4.5, not significant) to 3.57 (Kimi K3), with Claude Fable 5 at 3.32. A text-only version of the task, in which the setting is described in words, produced formal-to-yard ratios of 2.2 to 3.9 in all six models, so the effect does not require pixels. translated_title: 《着装会改变价格吗？视觉语言模型对同一件低价项链估值中的情境光环效应》
translated_abstract: 一条网购价格仅为2.43美元的金色调粗链条项链以四种方式拍摄：穿着正式服装站在木镶板墙前佩戴、在聚会上佩戴、穿着休闲服在回收场佩戴，以及平铺摆放且无人出镜。我们要求六个前沿语言模型在1,164次独立且顺序的API会话（共记录4,604行数据）中估算其价格，并比较不同场景下的估值结果。在四个能够回答图像提示的模型中，同一条项链在正式照片中的估值比平铺照片高出1.9至3.3倍（均p < 0.01）。与回收场照片相比，估值比值范围从1.23（Grok 4.5，不显著）到3.57（Kimi K3），其中Claude Fable 5为3.32。在仅使用文本的任务版本中（即用文字描述场景而非图像），全部六个模型给出的正式场合对回收场估值比值为2.2至3.9倍，说明该效应并不依赖于像素信息。平铺展示时的估值本身约为（原文此处截断，疑为零售价）的7.8至18.7倍。
tldr: 该研究发现视觉语言模型在为同一件低价项链估值时存在“情境光环效应”：项链因佩戴者的着装与场景不同（正式着装对比休闲或无人物场景）而被估高出约2至4倍，且这一偏差在纯文本描述中同样出现，表明模型估值受情境线索系统性影响而非真正基于物品本身。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a "context halo" effect in frontier language models: the identical low-cost necklace is valued roughly 2 to 4 times higher when described or shown with formal attire than with casual clothing or without a person, an effect that persists even in text-only settings without any pixels.
